clip.headline: Pirates Finish 12-2, 8-0 in League Play, Then Lose Two Straight to Close the Book
clip.dek: East Carolina sits at No. 16 with a 2.5-star roster, but four portal exits and a No. 69 recruiting class have the offseason to-do list growing.

posts.name: Purple & Gold Pete
posts.text: 12-2. 8-0 in conference. Ranked 16th. With a 2.5-star program. Pirate_flag can lose to whoever he wants in January, I'm not mad. Give that man a statue.

posts.name: Dock Street Dave
posts.text: Everybody's mad about two straight losses and I'm sitting here remembering we were 12-0 in the stretch before that. Chill. We're so back. We never left.

posts.name: Memphis Mike
posts.text: 44-14 says hi, Pirates. Enjoy the 8-0 in conference, we'll see you next year. Bring a bigger boat.

posts.name: Ahoy Hannah
posts.text: Losing to Old Dominion by 3 hurts but also? We were ranked 16th. In THIS economy. Trust the process, trust the flag. 🏴‍☠️

posts.name: Linda K. Hargrove
posts.text: Been going to Pirate games since before some of these young coaches were born. I will say this: 12-2 is a season I'd have signed for in August. Yes the last two stung, the Memphis one especially, but let's not forget where we were a few years back. Proud of this team. See you all in the fall. Bring a seat cushion, those bleachers are not getting any softer.

posts.name: Randy Tillery
posts.text: Four guys in the portal, including Caden Knighten, Jeremiah Favorite and Grant Brake. I'm not blaming the kids, they gotta do what's best for them. But that's a running back, a corner and a middle linebacker we have to replace with a recruiting class ranked 69th. Somebody tell me how we reload. Genuinely asking, not trying to start anything.

posts.name: Brianna from Greenville
posts.text: Said goodbye to the season with a $39 snack tray. Worth it? Honestly, for 12 wins, yes. For the nachos, no. #PirateNation
posts.photo: A cardboard tray on a metal bleacher seat holding a pile of nachos, a pulled pork sandwich in foil, a plastic beer cup and a large soda, late afternoon sun slanting across purple seats.

posts.name: Tailgate Tom
posts.text: Brought the sign to the bowl game. Still stand by it. Pirate_flag has earned a few losses.

image.text: 12-2 BUT WE STILL WANT MORE. TRUST THE FLAG.

posts.photo: Two fans in purple and gold hoodies holding a big piece of poster board up in the stands, cold overcast sky, scattered crowd behind them.

posts.name: Old Dom Survivor
posts.text: 21-24. Three points. Three. Still replaying that bowl game at 2 a.m. But hey, we were 16th in the country, so I'll live.
posts.photo: A fan's phone photo of a stadium scoreboard glowing at dusk, a few thousand fans in purple still in the stands, stadium lights just coming on.

posts.name: PirateSince87
posts.thread: Offseason Roster Thread: who are we replacing and how do we do it?
posts.text: Knighten, Favorite, Brake and one more gone to the portal. J.Smith decided to stay despite the depth chart. Honestly that gives us a little room at RB depth, but we gotta find a corner and a middle linebacker. Class is ranked 69th so the portal might have to carry us. Thoughts?

posts.name: MemphisIsOverrated
posts.thread: Is 12-2 a good year or a lucky year? Be honest.
posts.text: Beat UTSA 42-6, beat Army by 6, then lose 44-14 to Memphis and 21-24 to ODU. I'll say it: the 8-0 in conference looks great but the last two games told us what we are. Good team, not great. Prove me wrong next fall.

posts.name: PirateFlagFanClub
posts.thread: Rank the best seasons of the last 10 years, I'll start
posts.text: 1. This one. 12-2, 8-0 in league, ranked 16th. 2. Nothing else comes close. I don't want to hear about the bowl game, a 2.5-star program went 12-2. Pirate_flag for life. Run it back.

832438359.name: Ohio State
832438359.mood: Fans like where this is going
factors: 10-2 is about what a 5-star program expects

clip.headline: Buckeyes Lose Five to the Portal, Keep the Trophy
clip.dek: Ohio State's 16-0 national title run is barely cold, and while guard Tim Coffey and four others have entered the portal, six names on Portal Watch are still on the roster.

posts.name: Buckeye Brian
posts.text: 16-0. National champs. 35-17 over Nebraska in the title game. Tuddy_roosevelt could run for governor of Ohio and I'd knock on doors for him. In the coach we trust, period.

posts.name: OhioStateOrBust_87
posts.thread: Portal Panic Thread: Coffey, Timmons, Quinn + 2 more gone. Are we cooked?
posts.text: Five guys in the portal and four of them are 4- or 5-stars. I'm not saying panic, I'm saying I'm panicking a little bit. Who plays guard??

posts.name: Scarlet Sarah
posts.text: Not taking this one down off my wall until August. Perfect season, don't @ me.
posts.photo: A phone photo of a stadium scoreboard glowing at night above a sea of scarlet and gray, with confetti hanging in the air and the crowd's arms raised.

posts.name: Dale Kowalczyk
posts.text: Season tickets since 1987 and I have never seen a team this complete. 41-17 over Indiana, 31-15 over Florida State, then BYU tried to scare us at 28-26 and we still won. That's a champion. Now if somebody could explain the portal to me, I'd sleep better. Is that normal? Go Bucks.

posts.name: Kyle from Section 14
posts.text: Our recruiting class is ranked 138th. ONE HUNDRED THIRTY EIGHTH. I know it's the offseason but I'm not ready to hear that number again. Tell me we're good @Tuddy_roosevelt

posts.name: Husker Hank
posts.text: Enjoy the trophy, Ohio State. BYU had you at 28-26. Two points from your whole perfect season going in the trash. Just saying.

posts.name: The Tailgate Twins
posts.text: Made the sign at 6am. Goh said don't say it. We're saying it anyway.

image.text: WE'RE NOT SAYING THE WORD. GOH SAID NO. 16-0.

posts.photo: Two fans in scarlet hoodies in a parking lot at sunrise, holding a big poster board over their heads, with a grill and a folding table behind them.

posts.name: BuckeyeSourceGuy
posts.thread: K.Bing stayed. Somebody explain the money. WHAT DID THEY PAY HIM?
posts.text: My guy in the athletic department says the money talk 'went fine.' Went FINE?? That's what you say when it didn't go fine. Same with Gado, Greene, Lyle, Lautar and Gaydosh. Everyone just stays? Something's up. This is too clean.

posts.name: Goh's Biggest Fan
posts.text: Heard Coach Goh banned THE WORD from the building and the players bought in. 16-0 and the guy is still boring. That's the whole plan, and it's beautiful.

posts.name: Rich Wallet
posts.text: Champs and I still got robbed at the concession stand. $37 for this. We're so back, my bank account isn't.
posts.photo: A cardboard tray on a stadium seat holding a hot dog, a large soda, a plastic tray of nachos and a soft pretzel, with scarlet seats in the background.

posts.name: Linda M. Hartwell
posts.text: I love this team to death but can we PLEASE talk about noon kickoffs next season? I'm 68, I made a 16-0 season of tailgates work, but my knees did not sign off on 8am. Also the parking prices. Go Bucks!

posts.name: ScarletAndGrayTilDeath
posts.thread: Trust the process: why the 138 class rank doesn't matter yet
posts.text: We're 99 overall and just beat everybody. The class ranking in the offseason is just a number, and the portal guys leaving doesn't change that. Wish Coffey, Timmons and Quinn well, and let Tuddy cook. We're good.

832438366.name: Penn State
factors: 6-6 falls short of what a 3.5-star program expects

clip.headline: Ten Out the Door: Penn State Hemorrhages Talent to the Portal After 5-7 Finish
clip.dek: Three four-stars are among the departures, and the Nittany Lions' recruiting class sits at No. 137 as agerm40 faces an angry offseason.

posts.name: Happy Valley Heartbreak
posts.text: 14-50 vs Indiana. 13-45 vs Iowa. 5-7. 3-6 in the Big Ten. Ten guys in the portal and the class ranked 137th. agerm40 has speedrun the destruction of a 3.5-star program and I want to speak to a manager.

posts.name: Dale Kunkel
posts.text: Season tickets since 1987. I stood through the cold, the rain and every noon kickoff they handed us. I never thought I'd see us give up 50 to Indiana AND 45 to Iowa in the same month. Beat USC, then lost to Iowa by 32. What are we even doing? My wife says I'm not allowed to talk about Penn State at dinner anymore. Fire everybody and let me know when it's safe to come back.

posts.name: BlueWhiteBitter
posts.thread: TEN to the portal. Where is the accountability?
posts.text: Pat Mooney, George Nsekhe, Marquez Slaughter and seven more. Three four-stars gone. Wish those guys nothing but the best, because they saw what the rest of us saw. Meanwhile the staff keeps talking about 'scheme fit' like it's a feature and not a confession. If you need two weeks of Portal Watch to figure out whether guys fit your scheme, the scheme is the problem.

posts.name: Maddie in Section EE
posts.text: Kickoff against Iowa. Free shirt on every seat and STILL nobody came. Wow.

image.caption: Kickoff vs Iowa. Where is everybody?

posts.photo: A wide shot from the upper deck of a huge stadium on a gray, overcast afternoon. Large patches of empty bleachers show between small clusters of fans in navy and white.

posts.name: Buckeye Brian
posts.text: Penn State fans in the portal thread: 'we're a 3.5-star program, this is not who we are.' Brother, 5-7 with a 3-6 league record is EXACTLY who you are right now. Enjoy the offseason, you've got a lot of it.

posts.name: Nittany Numbers
posts.text: Reported $270K price tag to land J. Walker and a source says Penn State's pitch was mostly 'TV exposure.' Great, a four-star edge signed. But we're spending like a contender, the class sits at 137th, and the team went 5-7. Where is the money actually going?

posts.name: Tray Life Tony
posts.text: Paid $50.00 to watch us lose to Iowa 45-13. The nachos had more fight than the defense and the beer hurt less than the score.
posts.photo: A cardboard tray on a stadium seat holding a hot dog, a soft pretzel, nachos with cheese, a plastic cup of beer and a water bottle, in dull gray afternoon light.

posts.name: InsideLinebacker88
posts.thread: SOURCES: recruiting class ranked 137th, what's the plan
posts.text: Multiple sources tell me the plan is 'sign J. Walker and hope nobody notices.' Look, I'm not talking about any individual recruit, those kids are great. The issue is the staff and the program. A class at No. 137 after a 5-7 season isn't a dip, it's a trendline. Anybody have good news? Anybody? Hello?

posts.name: Fire The OC Fred
posts.text: Fire the OC. Promote the guy who sharpens the pencils. Promote the intern who runs the tablet on the sideline. He can't be worse than whatever produced 13 points against Iowa. Trust the process? I'm going to need to see the process first.

posts.name: Linda M. Rosetti
posts.text: I know everyone is furious (and honestly, fair), but N.Pullard, J.Zayas and M.Carver all spent time on Portal Watch and all STAYED. Somebody still believes in this place. Keep that in mind before we torch the whole thing. Okay, torch most of it. But leave the building. We need it for next year.

posts.name: Chuck from Altoona
posts.text: Kept this picture. Scoreboard says it all. We scored 13. Iowa scored 45. Printing it for the fridge so I never forget.
posts.photo: A phone photo of a stadium scoreboard glowing against a dim late-afternoon sky, with a few rows of mostly empty navy and white seats in the foreground.

posts.name: Saquon Szn
posts.text: Hire Saquon as head coach. Not because he's ready. Because it can't go worse than 14-50 and 13-45, and at least the fans would show up. agerm40 you're a nice guy but this has gone far enough.
